title: Expression and accumulation of heterologous molecules in the protein storage vacuoles of soybean seeds
protocol: Isolate genomic DNA from young leaves using the DNeasy Plant Kit.
Quantify genomic DNA concentration using a NanoDrop 3300.
Confirm DNA concentration by analysis on a 1% agarose gel stained with ethidium bromide.
Adjust DNA concentration to 10 ng/μl with distilled water.
Store isolated DNA at -20°C until PCR analysis.
Amplify the signal peptide and promoter region of the alpha' subunit from soybean beta-conglycinin using primers CongF and CongR.
Analyze amplified fragments on a PTC-100 Peltier thermal cycler.
Purify the PCR fragment using a QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit.
Quantify the purified PCR fragment using a NanoDrop.
Adjust the final concentration to 5 ng/ul with nuclease-free water.
Clone the adjusted PCR fragment into the pGEM-T Easy cloning vector.
Digest the vector pGEM-T Easy containing the amplified fragment with _Xho_ I and _Hin_d III.
Clone the resulting fragment into the pBluescript KS utilizing the same restriction sites.
Design primers 35STF and 35STR to amplify a 228-bp fragment containing the CaMV 35S terminator.
Utilize the pCAMBIA 2300 vector as a template for PCR amplification, creating _Eco_ RI and _Bam_ HI sites.
Purify the PCR-generated fragment from a 1% agarose gel.
Clone the purified fragment into a pGEM-T Easy vector.
Digest the cloned fragment using _Bam_ HI and _Eco_ RI.
Purify the insert after digestion.
Clone the purified insert into the previously obtained intermediate vector to generate pbetaCong1.
Utilize the pbetaCong1 vector as a model for cloning ten different genes encoding various molecules.
Clone each gene into pbetaCong1 using _Hin_d III and _Eco_ RI sites.
Use each construct at a concentration of 1 ug/ul in soybean transformation experiments.
Submit all obtained vectors to Macrogen Corp. (USA) for complete sequencing.
Digest the sequence containing human growth hormone and coix signal peptide from pRT-PGK-PShGH with _Nco_ I and _Bam_ HI.
Clone the digested sequence into pbetaCong3 using _Nco_ I and _Bam_ HI sites.
Digest the sequence containing scFv and coix signal peptide from pRT-PGK-PSscFv with _Nco_ I and _Bam_ HI.
Clone the digested fragment containing alpha-coixin signal peptide and 805-bp scFv into pbetaCong3 using _Nco_ I and _Bam_ HI sites.
Generate the 4,826-bp vector pbetaCong3scFv with a carboxy terminal 6xHis-tag.
Utilize plasmids pbetaCong3scFv and pAC 321 for soybean genetic co-transformation experiments in a 1:1 ratio.
Construct primers to add the monocot signal peptide α-coixin from Coix lacrima-jobi L.
Add Nco I and Bam HI sites before and at the terminus of CD-18.
Construct primers to add the monocot signal peptide α-coixin from Coix lacrima-jobi L.
Add Nco I and Bam HI sites before and at the terminus of FIX.

Utilize the constructed vector for obtaining transgenic soybean plants that express several genes of interest by bombardment of somatic embryonic axes from mature soybean seeds cv. BR-16 using a particle bombardment procedure.
Conduct genetic transformation, greenhouse plant cultivation, and molecular analysis according to protocols published in Nature Protocols.
Slice mature transgenic and nontransgenic seeds into 2 mm thick sections.
Fix the seed slices for 4 hours at 4°C in a sodium cacodylate buffer containing 2% paraformaldehyde and 0.5% glutaraldehyde at pH 7.2.
Wash the fixed seed slices three times in fixation buffer.
Dehydrate the seed slices for 1 hour each in ethanol solutions of 30%, 50%, 70%, 95%, and 100% under -20°C and partial vacuum conditions.
Infiltrate the samples with increasing concentrations of ethanol used to dilute LR White resin, from 30% to 100%, in 3-hour increments.
Incubate the samples for 8 hours in pure LR White resin.
Transfer the samples into 1.98% benzoyl peroxide in LR White resin and incubate at 4°C under UV light for 72 hours.
Collect ultra-thin sections (50 nm thick) on 400 mesh nickel grids.
Incubate the nickel nets with 1X PBS-T (phosphate-buffered saline with Tween 20 and bovine serum albumin) for 1 hour at room temperature.
Incubate the samples in rabbit polyclonal anti-specific molecule antibody diluted in PBS-T (1:500, 24 ng/μl) for 2 hours at room temperature.
Wash the samples for 1 hour in 1X PBS.
Incubate the samples with gold conjugated protein A in PBS solution (20 nM) for 2 hours at room temperature.
Wash samples in PBS.
Dry samples for 24 hours.
Contrast samples with 1% uranyl acetate in a 0.1 M PBS solution.
Observe samples under a Zeiss DSM 962 transmission electron microscope.
